picks.title: Sam Altman makes 'mic drop' offer to every Y Combinator startup
picks.why_it_matters: OpenAI offering tokens-for-equity to every YC startup signals a major shift in how AI infrastructure companies may compete for early-stage deal flow, potentially disrupting traditional VC dynamics and creating a new class of strategic investor.

picks.title: NanoClaw creator turns down $20M buyout offer, raises $12M seed instead
picks.why_it_matters: A founder rejecting a $20M acquisition for a $12M seed round signals strong conviction in the AI agent infrastructure space, and sandboxed/containerized agent execution is emerging as a critical security layer VCs should watch.

picks.title: This startup raised $43M to build a hive mind for ships
picks.why_it_matters: A $43M raise for maritime sensor technology highlights growing investor appetite for defense-adjacent and logistics infrastructure plays that modernize legacy systems with real-time data networks.
